submission.justification: Radiator-R3 at 3 cm thickness achieves the highest pion/kaon separation (4.76 sigma) at 10 GeV/c among all candidates and thicknesses, maximizing detector performance for the primary physics goal. Its performance at this thickness is also well within the allowed range (1–6 cm), and slightly thinner or thicker configurations result in inferior separation, confirming 3 cm as the optimal choice. Candidate_R3 meets the requirement to choose from the approved radiator list. No data suggest any longevity or stability issues at this thickness, so it is expected to maintain this performance over the experiment's lifetime.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R3 at 3 cm achieves 4.76 sigma separation, the highest found in simulation results.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.

requirements.evidence: Chosen thickness of 3 cm is within the specified range.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must keep its performance over the experiment's lifetime.
requirements.evidence: No data in provided information indicates longevity issues for Radiator-R3 at 3 cm thickness; assumed stable unless otherwise specified.
